components.name: application
components.strategy: redeploy the previously approved immutable backend artifact

components.name: migration
components.strategy: follow the reviewed per-revision downgrade classification; never downgrade automatically

components.name: collector
components.strategy: disable new collection starts, allow or cancel the bounded run, then restore the prior CLI artifact

components.name: frontend_assets
components.strategy: switch to the previously approved immutable dist artifact and invalidate only its asset namespace

components.name: scheduled_task
components.strategy: inspect, disable, and uninstall only the exact AgroSat collector task after human approval
